uncited: **Determine Fastest Axis:** Identify the axis along which the ray travels the furthest for a given length.
**Adjust Ray Start:** Adjust the ray origin to start on the closest cube face perpendicular to the fastest axis $k$.
**Scale Stepping Distance:** Scale the stepping distance of the fast voxel traversal algorithm so that the stepping distance along the fastest axis $k$ is exactly 1 unit.
**Align Sample Position:** Alter the fractional part of the sample point position so that it is zero in the fastest axis $k$, while retaining the fractional placement in the other two axes.
**Fast Voxel Traversal:** Perform fast voxel traversal as normal using the adjusted step sizes and t-values.
**Adaptive Termination:** For each sample, check if the accumulated opacity exceeds the threshold $\epsilon$.
for $i = 1, \dots, n$, where $n$ is the number of samples, $o_i$ is the opacity at sample $i$, and $o_{in}$ and $o_{out}$ are the opacities coming into and going out of sample $i$.
